last_review.summary: The implementation meets BE-006-01 acceptance criteria and architecture constraints. It adds a contract-compatible in-memory task model, centralized legal transitions, defensive copying, asynchronous FIFO processing with duplicate-scheduling protection, sanitized failure handling, minimal lifecycle events, and NestJS module wiring. The diff is confined to allowed paths, does not modify contracts or introduce forbidden integrations, and deterministic verification reports a successful TypeScript build and full-tree layering check.

notes: No tests are executed by this loop; build and full-tree layering check are the deterministic gates.
V1 is entirely in-memory. A restart loses conversations, tasks, event buffers, pending approvals and auth contexts.
NoktosClient runs against an explicitly labelled mock; noktos-auth exposes no public controllers yet.
The Supabase access token never reaches a prompt, event, task payload, log or UI.
contracts/ is frozen at 1.0.0 and is a protected path; changing it is a human operation.
